protocol.name: junban-phase2-scale-v1
notes: Rust seeder creates the fixture before server start; seed duration is recorded separately.
Queries always use limit<=100; the harness never lists all tasks in one response.
Quick mode (500 tasks / 1 sample) validates the harness only.
protocol.regression_rule: a per-phase warm-median increase above the larger of 20% or 2 MiB requires measured explanation and explicit acceptance; final 24/32 MiB ceilings cannot be waived
protocol.seeder: junban-scale-seed (scale-bench feature; not in release server artifacts)
protocol.token: deterministic per sample, pre-written owner-only access-token
protocol.variance_rule: same-commit warm median must remain within the larger of 15% or 1 MiB; otherwise repeat on an idle host and retain both reports

summary.regression_rule: a per-phase warm-median increase above the larger of 20% or 2 MiB requires measured explanation and explicit acceptance; final 24/32 MiB ceilings cannot be waived
summary.variance_rule: same-commit warm median must remain within the larger of 15% or 1 MiB; otherwise repeat on an idle host and retain both reports
